turns.content: I need a confident, professional LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. It's a compact camera with a hybrid viewfinder and a 23mmF2 lens. Can you craft something under 80 words?

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI, a compact camera designed for professionals. With its innovative hybrid viewfinder, you can effortlessly switch between optical and electronic modes for the perfect shot. The 23mmF2 lens ensures stunning clarity and depth in every image. Elevate your photography experience with the X100VI. Explore the possibilities today!
